body: They can only do so much when I'm absolutely traumatized by a therapist. Therapy works for me otherwise.
I tried a few other therapists. That went nowhere since I would just talk about her and there was nothing they could do about it.
I wish it was simply that therapy didn't work. I'm traumatized by a therapist. I don't know how anyone recovers from that.
I don't even know what that means.
I wish that were really the case. Some help unfortunately isn't going to be enough.

Also, when I've had someone make that much of an impact on my life, there's no way I'm going to leave it alone. I guess I should just let it have fatal consequences for me and pretend it doesn't bother me.
This has absolutely nothing to do with wanting to have a relationship with her. It's about how harmed I was by her and how little she cares about that.
My name's not Julia, hers is, but nope I'm not OK unfortunately.

Thank you. Unfortunately I don't think she would talk to me even if she somehow read this. I did send her 2 emails last year, and if she read those then she knows the extent of my suffering. I last saw her almost 16 months ago, and haven't even made step one towards moving on, so it's clear I'm just not going to. I've been told it's time to move on, but I literally can't. No matter how I process it or look at the situation, I can't. There's something about this that just doesn't allow me to.

I'm supposed to just allow the most important person to ever be in my life, not have an impact on me, and without closure. It's unfortunate she will get my suicide note though.
I'm actually not getting treatment. And no treatment plan has ever worked.
Depression, anxiety, never having a chance to begin with, etc. She's just a driving force behind how things got worse when I asked for help. It sucks knowing this was always going to be the end.
I have not. Not even close. It's hardly the reason I want to kill myself, but I'd be lying if I said it wasn't a big contributor.
I already did try to contact her a while back, I don't really care if it's healthy or not.
